label: Compare direct cooperation with mediation through the secondary exercise (inference)
rule: Derive productive reachability from actual groups, test contributor deletion and evaluate the original transfer predicate
meaning: Last-step induction computes the whole positive-length contributor-path relation in this press: the sole pair beyond single edges is drive to imprint through stroke in application. Conservation, co-production and application therefore yield different path credit without reassigning a final CausesIn edge. Removing drive or stroke separately tests the cooperative group's two contributors with its other members present. Retained power and present lending are checked separately. The truth of universal transfer in one finite profile concerns that interpretation alone.
